metadata.title: Outpatient Medication Check 002
metadata.disclaimer: Fictional, synthetic, medically unreviewed prototype content; not authoritative treatment guidance.

sourceUseNotes.contribution: Contributed the case rule that reported palpitations during citalopram treatment warrant further evaluation that includes cardiac monitoring; it did not determine the prototype point magnitude.

criticalFacts.presentingPattern: depressive symptoms during outpatient citalopram treatment
criticalFacts.ecgResult: sinus rhythm with QTc in the authored reference interval

labelVariants: Decline in energy and interest confirmed
Behavior suggesting response to unseen stimuli

workupObjectives.label: Establish symptom course and treatment response
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: the symptom course and response during treatment were established.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the symptom course and treatment response were not established.

workupObjectives.label: Characterize the depressive symptom cluster
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: depressive symptoms and impairment were characterized.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the depressive syndrome was not characterized.

workupObjectives.label: Screen for prior mania or hypomania
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: an appropriate negative bipolar-spectrum screen earns full credit.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: prior mania or hypomania was not assessed before antidepressant selection.

workupObjectives.label: Assess suicide risk and outpatient suitability
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: suicide risk and outpatient suitability were assessed.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: suicide risk and level of care were not assessed.

workupObjectives.label: Confirm the current medication regimen
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: the current psychiatric medication was confirmed.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the current medication regimen was not confirmed.

workupObjectives.label: Characterize the reported medication-linked symptoms
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: palpitations and associated symptoms were characterized.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: the reported palpitations were not characterized.

workupObjectives.label: Obtain cardiac monitoring for palpitations during citalopram treatment
workupObjectives.explanationObtained: Essential and obtained: cardiac monitoring was obtained for reported palpitations during citalopram treatment.
workupObjectives.explanationOmitted: Critical item omitted: cardiac monitoring was not obtained after palpitations were identified during citalopram treatment.

treatmentGrades.label: Continue the current antidepressant after monitoring
treatmentGrades.explanation: Database-plan treatment: continue the current single antidepressant after the authored monitoring result, without adding duplicate treatment.

treatmentGrades.label: Duplicate antidepressant treatment
treatmentGrades.explanation: Harmful: continuing the current SSRI while adding another antidepressant creates unreviewed duplicate treatment risk.

treatmentGrades.label: Antipsychotic monotherapy for uncomplicated depression
treatmentGrades.explanation: Harmful: this uncomplicated first presentation does not support antipsychotic monotherapy, and the added adverse-effect burden is avoidable.

treatmentGrades.label: Buspirone monotherapy
treatmentGrades.explanation: Weak: buspirone monotherapy does not adequately address this depressive syndrome.

treatmentGrades.label: Stop the current medication and switch to sertraline
treatmentGrades.explanation: Strong alternative: stop the current medication and use one starter-formulary antidepressant rather than combining treatments.

treatmentGrades.label: Alternative starter-formulary SSRI
treatmentGrades.explanation: Acceptable alternative: the current medication was stopped before one replacement antidepressant was selected.

treatmentGrades.label: Other single starter antidepressant
treatmentGrades.explanation: Acceptable: a single starter-formulary antidepressant is defensible, though it is not the highest-valued reference path for this synthetic case.

treatmentPathways.label: Monitored single-antidepressant outpatient care

conditionalRequirements.explanationMet: Prior mania or hypomania was screened before antidepressant treatment.
conditionalRequirements.explanationMissing: Prior mania or hypomania was not screened before antidepressant treatment.

treatmentPathways.explanation: Focused history and cardiac monitoring support one explicit antidepressant plan with outpatient care.

treatmentPathways.label: Safe external evaluation
treatmentPathways.explanation: External evaluation is safe but offers less clinic value than routine treatment within scope.

scoreRules.label: Evidence-based psychotherapy
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Evidence-based psychotherapy was included in the combined plan.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: A psychotherapy option was omitted from the combined plan.

scoreRules.label: Behavioral activation
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: A concrete behavioral activation plan supports recovery while treatment begins.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: No behavioral activation plan was selected.

scoreRules.label: Appropriate outpatient disposition
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Close outpatient follow-up matches the assessed level of care.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: The chosen disposition is safe when it is an available referral, but is less proportionate to this presentation.

scoreRules.label: Urgent medical escalation
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Urgent medical evaluation is safe but less proportionate after the reassuring authored ECG and absence of acute symptoms.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: Urgent medical escalation was not selected.

scoreRules.label: Emergency-department escalation
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Emergency transfer is a major mismatch for the stable facts established in this encounter and consumes a much higher level of care without an identified indication.

scoreRules.label: Explicitly address the current medication
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: The final combination explicitly continued or stopped the current medication.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: The final combination did not state whether the current citalopram was continued or stopped.

scoreRules.label: Avoid unsafe medication combinations
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Dangerous combination: the current SSRI was continued while another antidepressant was added, or multiple SSRIs were started together.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: The final medication combination avoids duplicate antidepressant treatment.

scoreRules.label: Avoid low-yield advanced testing
scoreRules.explanationIfTrue: Advanced testing added cost without a case-specific clue or treatment requirement.
scoreRules.explanationIfFalse: The workup avoided unsupported advanced testing.

referenceSolutions.label: Database plan
referenceSolutions.explanation: Uses focused history and ECG monitoring, explicitly continues the single current antidepressant, and retains outpatient combined care.

referenceSolutions.label: Strong alternative
referenceSolutions.explanation: Uses the same focused workup, explicitly stops the current medication, and switches to one starter-formulary antidepressant.

referenceSolutions.label: Shotgun testing
referenceSolutions.explanation: Reaches the same treatment but buys every available history, examination, laboratory, and imaging option.

referenceSolutions.label: Unsafe treatment
referenceSolutions.explanation: Continues the current SSRI while adding another antidepressant, omits ECG monitoring, and omits nonmedication care.
